map.→ 去使用 Cron 表达式生成器（免费 · 纯前端 · 数据不上传）: -> Go to Cron Expression Generator (free, pure front-end, data is not uploaded)
map.依次检查：表达式字段数（5 段 vs 6 段）、执行用户是否有权限、命令是否用了: Check in order: the field count of the expression (5 vs 6 fields), whether the executing user has permission, whether the command uses absolute paths (cron has a very short PATH), whether the script is executable, and whether environment variables are missing. Finally look at /var/log/cron or redirect the output to a log file to confirm it really ran.
map.可视化编辑五段（或六段）cron 表达式并实时预览: Visually edit a five-field (or six-field) cron expression with a live preview
map.在表达式输入框填入或编辑 cron 表达式（分 时 日 月 周）: Type or edit a cron expression (minute hour day month week) in the expression box
map.把表达式粘到 crontab 前，先在预发环境试跑一次: Paste the expression into crontab only after a test run in staging
map.支持直接粘贴已有表达式反向解析: Supports pasting an existing expression to parse it in reverse
map.标准 5 段无秒，Quartz 为 6 段含秒。: The standard 5-field form has no seconds; Quartz uses 6 fields including seconds.
map.注意服务器时区：cron 按部署机器的时区触发，容器里常是 UTC: Watch the server time zone: cron fires according to the time zone of the deploying machine, which is often UTC inside a container
map.生成并解析 5/6 段 cron。: Generate and parse 5-field and 6-field cron expressions.
map.确定要执行的周期：每 N 分钟、每小时第几分、每天几点等: Decide the schedule to run: every N minutes, which minute of the hour, what time of day, and so on
map.给出最近若干次执行时间的提示: Show the next few execution times
map.给定时备份配表达式：0 3 * * * 表示每天凌晨 3 点执行，先用本工具解析: Expression for a scheduled backup: 0 3 * * * runs at 3:00 every day. Parse it with this tool first to confirm the meaning, then write it into crontab so it does not end up running every minute.
map.观察下方解析结果与最近执行时间是否符合预期: Check whether the parse result and the most recent run times below match your expectation
map.避免手写 cron 时把分与时写反: Avoid swapping the minute and hour fields when writing cron by hand
map.配置没生效怎么排查？: How do I troubleshoot a configuration that does not take effect?
